target_and_backward_path: The reference proton is an odd fermionic spin-half Q=+e extended composite. Its current has independent Dirac/Pauli structure: <P'|J^mu|P>=e ubar(P')[F1(Q2) gamma^mu+i sigma^{mu nu} q_nu F2(Q2)/(2 M)]u(P); F1(0)=1. Spatial charge response, magnetic response, excitation and breakup channels matter, not only a positive charge label.

Reference strong content includes quark-gluon correlations, color-singlet physical states, sea pairs and spin/orbital contributions. Existing substrate SU4 is not SU3 color and supplies no established proton branch.

Backward hypothesis: primitive odd fermions deform a neutral compressible internal carrier. An overlapping three-body deformation load lowers one shared quantum deformation energy more than separated pair and singleton loads. Its correlated mobile bound state then has extended charge and spin structure and source-active recoil.

This is an autonomous finite microscopic carrier/deformation law, not an imported QCD action or renamed old neutral seed. The conjectured local substrate supplier of its neutral carrier is deliberately not identified yet.

neutral_mediator_mechanism.physical_interpretation: A shared deformation produces both pair-load squares and cross-load products: K^2=sum f_ij^2+2 sum distinct-pairs f_ij f_kl. The latter are genuine cooperative three-constituent attraction. Mobile K does not commute with hopping, so integrating out the oscillator statically would erase the dynamic entanglement measured by the actual consumer.
neutral_mediator_mechanism.scope: Exact square completion on the untruncated oscillator; the executed law is its explicitly finite n-level compression. The square identity is not substituted for the diagonalization.
neutral_mediator_mechanism.fragment_reference: All oscillator energies use omega n (vacuum=0). When one fermion is taken far from a dressed pair, all cross f values vanish in the infinite-ring extension, leaving exactly the pair oscillator plus a decoupled free singleton. Singleton K=0 and its extra oscillator vacuum contributes zero; no independent charged-polaron dressing is added. Three separated singles have energy -6t=-1.5. Finite-ring sum thresholds are declared finite-domain evidence, not proved infinite-separation spectral edges.
neutral_mediator_mechanism.not_confinement: Finite-range deformation attraction permits dissociation; no confinement or SU3 Gauss law follows. Binding is a microscopic candidate result, not identification with QCD.

electromagnetic_operators.intrinsic_charge: The translation-invariant laboratory expectation at nonzero reciprocal q vanishes; it is NOT the intrinsic form factor. Unwrap other constituents around flavor0, subtract equal-mass mean, then F(q)=<sum qi exp(iq ri)>; chart noncompact probability is reported. This is a 1D candidate charge form factor, not a proton Sachs form factor.

Diagonalize U_kdag H U_k, then compute actual <psi_k|rho(k)|psi_0> and <psi_k|J(k)|psi_0> with its own recoil DeltaE. No mass or source normalization is borrowed from another root.

spin_and_statistics.spin: Three input spin-half fermions allow S=1/2 or 3/2 at Sz=1/2. AF pair exchange selects an actual S2=3/4 ground state in the executed block; choosing Sz alone does not select S2.
spin_and_statistics.statistics: A trimer source is sum psi(x,s,n) (bdag)^n/sqrt(n!) c_A^dag c_B^dag c_C^dag |vac>. It has odd CAR parity; exchanging two disjoint trimer source supports contributes (-1)^(3*3)=-1. This is primitive quantum fermion inheritance, not derived classical spin-statistics.
spin_and_statistics.identical_up_quark_obligation: The two positive flavors are presently distinguishable primitives, not two admitted identical up quarks with color-antisymmetric wavefunctions. Deriving an actual internal color representation and its Pauli-consistent correlated state remains necessary.
